text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The study focuses on the Indus Delta region in Pakistan, which is a regional-scale area—not national-scale. Although it includes LULC prediction using the MOLUSCE model and compares multiple SSP scenarios with quantitative outputs and accuracy metrics, it fails the core inclusion criterion of "explicit national-scale spatial implementation (entire country)." The study area is clearly defined as the Indus Delta (approximately 0.6 million hectares in Sindh Province), not all of Pakistan. Therefore, it meets exclusion criterion: "Local/regional/global/transboundary scale focus.")
